effects.display_name: Entropy Conduit native boss-health supply and attacker-dependent death request
effects.actual_behavior: Each callback sets noGravity, selects nearest Diabolos in ORIGINAL-XYZ full-side150 cube, with no owner/link/alive/target gate. InsideWall serverdiscard does not return; no nearest serverdiscard. In native Crawling dimension, boss-height branch <60/<120/<230/<256 requires respectively pylonY<60, strict60..120, strict120..230, strict230..256; higher bossY discards. Conduit absoluteY+.4 if below bossY-16, -.4 if above+16, else0/XZ0. Preincrement rawpylon_timer_heal>400: if>800 serverdiscard without return, beam-vector(dx,bossY+15-(pylonY+7),dz) must have nonzero length. Then heal_time_lim<=0: Living boss HP<max writes setHealth(currentHP+1F), not heal() or LivingHealEvent; reset20 even at fullHP, else-1. Native period21 eligible callbacks, no alive gate or cancellation added. At end age+=1 regardless nearest/band. Actor native concrete hurt exclusions and fire/explosion/fall immunity preserve defenses; canBeCollidedWith AlwaysTrue is collision, NOT invulnerability. Constructor NoAI=false, no custom goals. die calls parent THEN passes DamageSource.getEntity (causing attacker, not direct entity and not pylon) to helper. Null attacker means no entire helper; nonnull: visual SphereAnim setup aside, presence Diabolos full-side150 selects current nearest, removes its Invincible effect BEFORE separate nearest GENERIC source-with-attacker request100. Hurt result ignored; no guarantee 100 accepted health loss. No duplicate cap or global damage rules added. tickDeath native removal/drop at5; mere discard does not invoke die helper.
